title: webview-chat bridge protocol v1 conformance case
description: One request the page sends, the API calls a conforming host makes for it (with the answers the API gives), and the response the host must send back. See PROTOCOL.md, Conformance cases.

host.description: What the host application supplies. The page cannot set any of it.

startedConversations.description: Conversations the page started earlier in this session, as the host tracked them.

startedTurns.description: Generic Intake turns the host returned earlier in this session: from a start result, an IntakeTurnRunning error, or the activeTurnId of a getConversation result.

userFile.description: attachFile only: the file the user picks, or null when the user closes the picker.

request.description: The request as the page sends it, parsed from its JSON string.

requestIsValid.description: Present when the request deliberately fails the messages schema.

apiCalls.description: Every HTTP call the host makes, in order. A host makes no other call.

operationId.description: The API operation, or null for the PUT to a presigned upload URL.

path.description: API path, relative to the API base URL.

url.description: Absolute URL, for the presigned upload only.

headers.description: Every X-Actor-* and If-None-Match header the call carries, with its exact value. A call carries none that are not listed. Authorization is always the tenant API key and is not listed.

body.description: The exact JSON body. Absent when the call has none.

bodySizeBytes.description: Presigned upload only: the number of bytes sent.

response.description: The response the host sends back, validated by messages.schema.json#/$defs/Response.
